mapper.select: SELECT c.id, c.post_id, c.parent_id, c.content, c.like_count, c.created_at, u.id AS user_id, u.username, u.nickname, u.avatar, ru.id AS reply_to_user_id, ru.username AS reply_to_username, ru.nickname AS reply_to_nickname, IF(lk.id IS NOT NULL, TRUE, FALSE) AS is_liked FROM comment c JOIN user u ON c.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN user ru ON c.reply_to_uid = ru.id LEFT JOIN user_like lk ON lk.target_id = c.id AND lk.target_type = 2 AND lk.user_id = #{userId} WHERE c.parent_id = #{parentId} AND c.status = 1 ORDER BY c.created_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comment WHERE parent_id = #{parentId} AND status = 1
